name: General Woodcraft Inc
old_description: Founded in 1949, General Woodcraft has a proud heritage of quality that we think is evident in the projects you see throughout this site. Our many clients, architects, designers, builders, contractors and discerning homeowners, and their projects, speak to the professional performance – on time and within budget – which we consistently deliver.
about:
General Woodcraft Inc. was founded in 1949 in New London, Connecticut. The company began as a woodworking shop serving local builders and has grown into a supplier of custom millwork and a broad inventory of domestic and exotic hardwoods.

The firm operates a custom woodworking and architectural millwork facility producing custom mouldings, mantels, countertops, and wooden boat parts. It also stocks marine-grade plywood, a wide range of figured and exotic lumber, bamboo, and hardwood plywood. General Woodcraft is the exclusive North American distributor of Mataverde premium Ipe decking and the Climate-Shield rain screen system, and offers the Eurotec deck system and Trespa Pura NFC panels.

Its customers include architects, designers, contractors, and homeowners across the woodworking, marine, and construction industries. Notable projects include supplying teak for the U.S. Coast Guard barque Eagle and the Mystic Seaport Museum's Joseph Conrad, as well as decking for the Treasure Island Casino in Las Vegas and the Clinton Presidential Library in Little Rock.

The company emphasizes a set of operating principles called TRACC — Trust, Respect, Attitude, Communication, and Consistency — and states a commitment to environmentally responsible sourcing through sustained-yield forestry practices.
